# windows_smb_share (Resource)

Manages a single SMB share on a remote Windows host over SSH + PowerShell: the share itself (`New-SmbShare` / `Set-SmbShare` / `Remove-SmbShare`) plus its share-level access entries (`Grant-SmbShareAccess` / `Block-SmbShareAccess` / `Revoke-SmbShareAccess`).

The shared directory itself is never created here: pair this resource with `windows_directory`, which owns the directory entry. NTFS permissions stay with `windows_file_acl`; Windows evaluates share and NTFS permissions together, the most restrictive winning.

When all four of `full_access`, `change_access`, `read_access` and `no_access` are omitted, the host access list is unmanaged: it is left untouched and never diffed. When at least one is configured, all four become authoritative: an empty set revokes every entry at that level, and any out-of-band entry (including the `Everyone:Read` entry `New-SmbShare` creates by default) is revoked as stale. A principal may belong to at most one set.

`encrypt_data` defaults to `false`, matching the Windows default; enabling it (`true`) is recommended whenever the share carries sensitive data, so traffic cannot be read off the wire.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A finance share with access-based enumeration, no offline caching and
# encrypted transport. The shared directory must already exist (manage it
# with windows_directory); it is never created here.
resource "windows_smb_share" "finance" {
  name                    = "Finance"
  path                    = "D:\\Shares\\Finance"
  description             = "Finance department share"
  folder_enumeration_mode = "AccessBased"
  caching_mode            = "None"
  encrypt_data            = true
  full_access             = ["BUILTIN\\Administrators"]
  change_access           = ["FINANCE\\Managers"]
  read_access             = ["Everyone"]
}

# An unmanaged share: with all four access sets omitted the host access list
# is left untouched and never diffed. Declare any of the sets to take over
# authoritatively (empty = revoke everything at that level).
resource "windows_smb_share" "scratch" {
  name = "Scratch"
  path = "D:\\Shares\\Scratch"

  # Bound every remote operation explicitly. Without this block each operation
  # defaults to 10 minutes; a stalled PowerShell/SSH session then surfaces a
  # timeout diagnostic instead of blocking Terraform indefinitely.
  timeouts = {
    create = "10m"
    read   = "5m"
    update = "10m"
    delete = "10m"
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) SMB share name. ForceNew. Reserved administrative names (IPC$, ADMIN$, <drive-letter>$) are rejected at plan time.
- `path` (String) Local absolute path of the shared directory on the target host (a trailing backslash is normalised away). The directory must already exist at apply time; it is never created here. ForceNew.

### Optional

- `caching_mode` (String) Offline file caching mode: `None`, `Manual` (the default), `Programs`, `Documents` or `BranchCache`.
- `change_access` (Set of String) Trustees granted change share access. Same identity semantics as `full_access`. Granting `Everyone` or `Authenticated Users` here warns (but still applies): prefer least privilege.
- `concurrent_user_limit` (Number) Maximum number of concurrent users (0 means no limit).
- `description` (String) Free-form description of the share (≤256 characters).
- `encrypt_data` (Boolean) Whether SMB encryption is required for the share. Defaults to `false`; enabling it (`true`) is recommended whenever the share carries sensitive data.
- `folder_enumeration_mode` (String) Whether users see only the files they can read (`AccessBased`) or everything (`Unrestricted`, the default).
- `full_access` (Set of String) Trustees granted full share access, as SIDs (`S-1-5-32-544`), qualified names (`BUILTIN\Administrators`, `DOMAIN\user`) or bare local names. Compared by SID: renaming or re-qualifying an account does not produce a spurious diff. Authoritative when any access set is configured; unmanaged when all four are omitted.
- `no_access` (Set of String) Trustees explicitly denied share access (`Block-SmbShareAccess`). Same identity semantics as `full_access`.
- `read_access` (Set of String) Trustees granted read share access. Same identity semantics as `full_access`.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Share name. Identical to the import ID format.
- `special` (Boolean) Whether the share is administrative (`ADMIN$`, `C$`, `IPC$`). Special shares are owned by Windows and cannot be imported; they are reported here for visibility.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Read operations occur during any refresh or planning operation when refresh is enabled.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import a share by its SMB share name.
# ID format: <name>
# Special (administrative) shares (ADMIN$, C$, IPC$) are owned by Windows and
# cannot be imported. Access sets start unmanaged (null) after import: declare
# them to take over the access list authoritatively.
terraform import windows_smb_share.finance 'Finance'
```
